authorities.name: Central Board of Secondary Education, Regional Office, Chennai
authorities.pio_address: CBSE, Regional Office, Chennai, New No. 3 (Old no. 1630-A), J Block, 16th Main Road, Anna Nagar West, Chennai – 600040 (Tamil Nadu)
authorities.quote: Under Secretary / CPIO CBSE, Regional Office, Chennai New No. 3 (Old no. 1630-A), J Block, 16th Main Road, Anna Nagar West, Chennai – 600040 (Tamil Nadu)
authorities.note: Entry 18 of the CBSE office order dated 24 Feb 2026 (linked from https://www.cbse.gov.in/cbsenew/rti.html): the CPIO for all matters of the Chennai Regional Office, with jurisdiction Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Andaman and Nicobar Islands. The First Appellate Authority is the Regional Director at the same address. The PDF is a scanned image, so the quote was read from the rendered page (OCR plus a visual check). The RTI page also publishes a format for obtaining a photocopy of an answer book.

authorities.name: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation, Regional Office, Chennai
authorities.pio_address: Regional Office, Chennai (North), No. 37, Royapettah High Road, Opposite Swagat Hotel, (TN). Chennai - 600 014
authorities.quote: Regional Office, Chennai (North) No. 37, Royapettah High Road, Opposite Swagat Hotel, (TN). Chennai - 600 014 ... Regional P. F. Commissioner (Gr.I)
authorities.note: The directory lists Chennai (North) and Chennai (South) at this same address and does not mark which officer is the CPIO. The EPFO Information Handbook (https://pmvbry-cdn.epfindia.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/RTI_InformationHandbook-1.pdf) says Regional Commissioners-I in charge of Regions are designated CPIO for the regional and sub-regional offices under them, so the Gr.I Regional P. F. Commissioner is used here. Offices in the rest of Tamil Nadu (Coimbatore, Madurai, Trichy and others) are listed separately in the directory: use the office that holds the member's account.

authorities.name: Regional Passport Office, Chennai
authorities.pio_address: Regional Passport Office, Rayala Towers 2 & 3, IV Floor, 158, Anna Salai, Chennai 600 002, Tamil Nadu
authorities.quote: Deputy Passport Officer, Regional Passport Office, Rayala Towers 2 & 3, IV Floor, 158, Anna Salai, Chennai 600 002, Tamil Nadu
authorities.note: Listed under 'Central Public Information Officer' in the office's Section 4(1)(b) disclosure; the First Appellate Authority is the Regional Passport Officer at the same address. The office issues passports for Chennai, Kancheepuram, Tiruvallur, Tiruvannamalai, Vellore, Villupuram, Cuddalore, Dharmapuri, Krishnagiri and Puducherry. RTI Online lists only the Ministry of External Affairs Consular, Passport and Visa Division, not this office, so file by post or in person.

authorities.name: Southern Railway, Headquarters, Chennai
authorities.pio_address: General Managers Office, 1st Floor, Southern Railway, Park Town, Chennai-600003
authorities.quote: Dy.General Manager/G, General Managers Office, 1st Floor, Southern Railway, Park Town, Chennai-600003
authorities.note: List of CPIOs as on 13.10.2026, entry 2: the CPIO for General Branch, ZRUCC, arbitration and allotment of officers' quarters. The Nodal Public Information Officer is the Deputy General Manager/G. Other headquarters subjects (security, accounts, signal and telecommunication, personnel, commercial, safety) have their own CPIOs in the same list, and each division has a separate list. The PDF is a scanned image, so the quote was read from the rendered page (OCR plus a visual check). It is linked from https://oldsr.indianrailways.gov.in/view_section.jsp?lang=0&id=0,7,331.

authorities.name: Income Tax Department, Chennai
authorities.quote: Public Relation Office Income-tax Officer(HQrs)(Public Relations), Chennai Addl. Commissioner of Income-tax (Hqrs)(Admn), Chennai No.121, M.G. Road, Chennai 600034
authorities.note: The 'Public Relation Office' row of the list of CPIOs and appellate authorities of the Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax (Tamil Nadu and Puducherry), Chennai, linked from https://tnincometax.gov.in/list_of_cpios, which shows 'Last Updated on : 28/02/2024', so recheck. The same list designates a CPIO for every office and ward in Chennai: a request about one taxpayer's file belongs with the CPIO of the office that holds it.

authorities.name: Indian Institute of Technology Madras
authorities.pio_address: Indian Institute of Technology Madras, Chennai - 600 036, Tamil Nadu
authorities.quote: All matters related to recruitment of faculty and staff. Miscellaneous RTI Queries CPIO ... Joint Registrar, Recruitment ... Address of the Institute: Indian Institute of Technology Madras Chennai - 600 036 Tamil Nadu
authorities.note: The CPIO shown for 'Miscellaneous RTI Queries' (with recruitment of faculty and staff). The page also names a Nodal Officer (Joint Registrar, RTI) who forwards requests to the CPIOs, and separate CPIOs for courses, research, administration, finance, students, purchases and other subjects. The postal address is the Institute address in the same page's disclosure section.

authorities.name: Unique Identification Authority of India, Regional Office, Bengaluru
authorities.pio_address: UIDAI Regional Office, Khanija Bhavan, No. 49, 3rd Floor, South Wing Race Course Road, Bengulru – 560 001.
authorities.quote: Matters related to Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry & Lakshdweep UIDAI Regional Office, Khanija Bhavan, No. 49, 3rd Floor, South Wing Race Course Road, Bengulru – 560 001. ... Director
authorities.note: 'List-II: CPIO and First Appellate Authority at Regional Offices and Tech Center, Bengaluru (as on 26.05.2025)': the Bengaluru Regional Office is the CPIO office for Tamil Nadu matters. The list is older than 180 days, so recheck. The source spells the city 'Bengulru'; the address is kept as published and the PIN is 560 001.

authorities.name: University of Madras
authorities.quote: Public Information Officer Assistant Registrar, RTI Whom it is to be Addressed Public Information Officer University of Madras Chepauk, Chennai - 600005.
authorities.note: The University's single Public Information Officer for RTI; the appellate authority is the Registrar at the same address. This covers the University's own records, such as examination results and certificates. Listed on RTI Online Tamil Nadu under the Higher Education Department.

authorities.name: Directorate of Government Examinations
authorities.pio_address: DIRECTORATE OF GOVERNMENT EXAMINATIONS, DPI CAMPUS, CHENNAI-6.
authorities.quote: JOINT DIRECTOR (PERSONNEL) NFORMATION RELATED TO S.S.L.C EXAMINATION AND ESTABLISHMENT DIRECTORATE OF GOVERNMENT EXAMINATIONS, DPI CAMPUS, CHENNAI-6.
authorities.note: The PIO for S.S.L.C examination and establishment matters. Information on the Higher Secondary examination goes to the Joint Director (Higher Secondary), at the same address (the page spells the heading 'NFORMATION'). The Appellate Authority is the Director. Listed on RTI Online Tamil Nadu under the School Education Department.

authorities.name: Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission
authorities.pio_address: Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission, TNPSC Road, Broadway, Chennai-600003
authorities.quote: Right to Information Petitions Right to Information Department (RID) Under Secretary (RID) ... Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission, TNPSC Road, Broadway, Chennai-600003
authorities.note: The PIO for 'Right to Information Petitions'. The same page names a different Under Secretary for each subject (applications, question papers and answer keys, valuation of answer sheets, selection, grievances and others); the appellate authority is the Joint Secretary or Deputy Secretary. The address is the Commission's address in the page footer. Listed on RTI Online Tamil Nadu under the Human Resources Management Department.

authorities.name: Greater Chennai Corporation
authorities.pio_designation: Executive Engineer, Bus Route Roads Department
authorities.pio_address: Greater Chennai Corporation, Amma Maligai, Ripon Building Campus, Chennai-600 003.
authorities.quote: Executive Engineer, Bus Route Roads Department, Greater Chennai Corporation, Amma Maligai, Ripon Building Campus, Chennai-600 003.
authorities.note: The PIO for the Bus Route Roads subject; the Superintending Engineer of that department is the appellate authority. The page lists about thirty PIOs by subject (buildings, bridges, electrical, mechanical, public relations office and others) and separate PIOs for each regional office, so pick the subject that matches the request. Listed on RTI Online Tamil Nadu under the Municipal Administration and Water Supplies Department.

authorities.pio_address: O/o Commissioner of Civil Supplies and Consumer Protection, Ezhilagam IV Floor, Chepauk, Chennai - 600 005
authorities.quote: O/o Commissioner of Civil Supplies and Consumer Protection, Ezhilagam IV Floor, Chepauk, Chennai - 600 005 Deputy Commissioner-1

authorities.name: Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board
authorities.name_ta: சென்னை பெருநகர் குடிநீர் வழங்கல் மற்றும் கழிவு நீரகற்று வாரியம்
authorities.pio_address: No.1, Pumping Station Road, Chintadripet, Chennai-02.
authorities.quote: Operation and Maintenance - Water and Sewer Registration - Complaints Assistant Executive Engineer(Registration.) Executive Engineer - AOBM Superintending Engineer-North ... Address No.1, Pumping Station Road, Chintadripet, Chennai-02.
authorities.note: The PIO for operation and maintenance, water and sewer registration and complaints; the Superintending Engineer-North is the appellate authority. authorities.name: District Collectorate, Chennai
authorities.quote: Personal Assistant (G) to the Collector Chennai Collectorate Chennai - 1
authorities.note: Entry 11 of the list of PIOs for the Chennai district (the appellate authority is the District Revenue Officer). Entries 14 and 15 of the same list place the Collector's office at 'Singaravelar Maligai, No. 32 Rajaji Salai, Chennai - 1'. Each taluk (Aminjikarai, Ayanavaram, Egmore, Guindy, Mambalam, Mylapore, Perambur, Purasaiwakkam, Tondiarpet, Velachery) has its own PIO in the list. The list carries no date. Whether this office is onboarded on RTI Online Tamil Nadu was not checked.

authorities.name: Inspector General of Registration, Tamil Nadu
authorities.quote: Office of the Inspector General of Registration, Chennai 28 P.I.O. Assistant Inspector General of Registration (Vigilance) ... 100 Santhome High Road, Chennai 28
authorities.note: The PIO of the Inspector General's office; the appellate authority is the Additional Inspector General of Registration (Stamps and Registration). Registered documents are held by the Sub-Registrar office of the area, and every zone, district and sub-registrar office has its own PIO in the same list. The list carries no date, so recheck. Listed on RTI Online Tamil Nadu under the Commercial Taxes, Registration and Religious Endowments Department.

authorities.name: Teachers Recruitment Board, Tamil Nadu
authorities.pio_address: Teachers Recruitment Board, 3rd And 4th Floors, Puratchi Thalaivar Dr MGR Centenary Building, Perasiriyar Anbalagan Kalvi Valaagam, College Road Chennai 600006.
authorities.quote: Submission of Applications and Application related information Notification Superintendent ... Teachers Recruitment Board, 3rd And 4th Floors, Puratchi Thalaivar Dr MGR Centenary Building, Perasiriyar Anbalagan Kalvi Valaagam, College Road Chennai 600006.
authorities.note: The Superintendent of the Notification section is the PIO for applications and application-related information (updated as on 01.10.2026).
